rows.grounds: fused form of kasya + api indicating any person
quotation marker closing the declared statement

items.question: Under what conditions may this teaching be communicated to another person?
premises: The teaching is declared to be not impartable.
No person is permitted as a recipient.
This prohibition applies at all times.
items.inference: Therefore, the teaching must never be communicated to anyone.
uncertainties: The specific content referred to as impartable depends on the preceding context.
items.plain_english: Thus I declare: this is never to be imparted to anyone.
